limits: operator new is a native heap allocation stand-in.
operator delete is a native heap release stand-in.
realloc is a scripted native CRT allocation boundary; cases preserve copied bytes and allocation lifetime.
lstrlenA is a scripted Windows string-length boundary.
InterlockedDecrement is a scripted Windows atomic decrement boundary.

Original realloc failure and null-key lookup fault inside the saved-EBP diagnostic read at address 4; the ordinary comparison cannot certify their fault outcomes or their unreachable normal-return continuations.
The insert entry uses the ordinary context-free ABI. Its no-prior-lookup error path reads inherited EBP before loading the key; arbitrary inherited CPU inputs are outside this family contract.
Later registration groups may link the read-only core bridge as an auxiliary source; this family owns only its 11 listed entries, not callback bodies or the legacy whole bootstrap.
notes: The 11 seeded functions own registry/index algorithms and first registrations, but no callback bodies. Diagnostic accessors remain original code with explicit compiler contexts; callbacks are stored as data.
